faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed PUC/10+2. Additionally, a strong command over the local language (written, spoken, and reading) and English is essential.

faq.answer: Yes, a valid Driver's License and a Motorcycle are mandatory requirements for this position, as it involves field work.
